title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds a new set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling quickstart examples, and updates to the docs site navigation and quickstart index. Motivation: provide customers with production-ready examples for agent + tool-calling patterns using Redwood APIs, reduce onboarding time for RAG workflows, and publish canonical templates that match the latest tool-calling semantics. This PR bundles: 1) three agent template YAMLs (assistant, question-answering, multi-tool dispatcher), 2) two language-specific quickstarts (python + typescript) showing tool registration and streaming responses, 3) updated docs site sidebar and quickstarts index page, 4) small fixes to the agent API reference (clarifying tool schema and credential handling). Checklist: - [x] Agent templates authored and validated locally - [x] Python & TypeScript quickstarts added with runnable steps - [x] Docs site builds locally and passes linkcheck - [x] CI passing (unit + lint + docs build) - [x] Reviewed by Docs and Runtime teams Notes: the description below includes example usage and caveats. The templates intentionally use the new "tool_call" field introduced in ENG-2045 and provide guidance on safe tool invocation (time limits, idempotency). Related: ENG-2045 (agent tool-calling launch), PM-321 (quickstart metrics), previous doc PRs adding RAG quickstarts (see recent series).
